proposed_widenings.name: compound_spell (activation_with_ongoing)
proposed_widenings.justification: Regenerate has both an immediate activation phase (4d8+15 heal on cast) and a persistent ongoing effect (1 HP/turn for 1 hour). No current family models this combination. The activation family covers one-shot resolution; the ongoing_effect family covers persistent operations with no initial burst. A compound family — or some form of multi-phase composition across families — is required.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "A creature you touch regains 4d8 + 15 Hit Points. For the duration, the target regains 1 Hit Point at the start of each of its turns"

proposed_widenings.name: HealEffect (spell Effect union)
proposed_widenings.justification: Spell Effect is currently `DamageEffect | NoneEffect`. The immediate 4d8+15 HP restoration on cast is a heal, not damage. The class-feature layer already has HealHpEffect; the spell layer needs a corresponding heal variant so the tracer can emit a `heal` atom for spell-triggered healing.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "A creature you touch regains 4d8 + 15 Hit Points"

proposed_widenings.name: periodic_heal (OngoingOperation union)
proposed_widenings.justification: OngoingOperation is currently `RollModifierOperation | DamageOnHitOperation`. The per-turn 1-HP regen is a time-gated heal that fires at the start of each of the target's turns, not on a hit and not a roll modifier. A new periodic_heal variant with a turn-start trigger and a fixed HP amount is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "the target regains 1 Hit Point at the start of each of its turns"

proposed_widenings.name: restore_body (or extend apply_condition / return_on_end)
proposed_widenings.justification: Severed body part regrowth has no counterpart in the v4 atom inventory. It is a physical restoration effect triggered after a time delay (2 minutes). The closest atom `return_on_end` handles returning state at spell end, not restoring physical anatomy after an in-spell timer. If this is not treated as dm_agenda, a new atom is needed. It may be legitimately out-of-scope per ARCHITECTURE.md (narrative/physical outcome not a deterministic combat mechanic), but the gap should be recorded.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "any severed body parts regrow after 2 minutes"

notes: Regenerate cannot be honestly encoded in any current family. The structural gap is the compound effect shape (immediate heal + ongoing per-turn regen). Two additional surface widenings are also required before even the compound shape could be expressed: a heal variant in spell Effect, and a periodic_heal variant in OngoingOperation. The body part regrowth is a secondary rider that may qualify as dm_agenda (physical restoration is caller-owned in ARCHITECTURE.md terms), but is recorded here as a potential atom gap. No dhall or JSON authored.
